'X4 sold as legal Ectasy substitute. oMPP, mCPP, pCpp, TFMPP HCL'
Finally after weeks of waiting, the time seemed right for me and my wife to try out X4,the new, legal alternative to MDMA (or so the adverts said). I 'm around 150 pounds and she is about 100 pounds. We're no strangers to psychedelics and were looking forwards to trying out this new 'drug'. We had taken no drugs for about 3 weeks and taken no alcohol either.
The dose was one (1) tablet as recommended (Normal dose), which was stronger for my wife than I taking body mass/weight in to consideration.
The time frame etc. isn't very important as our horrible experience is almost identical to that of Murple's
'A trip to toxic city'
and
'Pie tasting'
.
X4 was very toxic for both my wife and I. It took us about 3 days to recover.
